backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing e-commerce backend with product/service listings, QRC client registration, order management, and order trace storage (txHash with last6 characters). Includes sample data, filtering/sorting queries, and mocked scraper functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented arbitrage features: arbitrage.ts module creation with set_arbitrage/get_arbitrage functions, and integration into Products.tsx order flow with 80% wholesale price calculation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including routing, pages (Home, Products, Services, Contact, Sitemap, Onboarding), arbitrage logic, styling, and React Query hooks for order trace fetching.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'e-Com Aggr. Services' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining six routes (home, products, services, contact, sitemap, onboarding) with Layout as root component and typed router registration.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Application layout with sticky header navigation (6 icon-labeled links), e-Com Aggr. Services branding, active route highlighting, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution and project description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook managing ICP actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, automatic actor recreation on identity changes, and dependent query invalidation/refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and status tracking (initializing, idle, logging-in, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hook (useOrderTrace) for fetching order trace data by orderId from backend actor, with conditional enabling based on actor availability and orderId presence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional e-commerce color palette for both light and dark modes, including primary (teal), accent (orange), and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts: Minimal arbitrage helper module that computes profit margins (p3 = p1 - p2) between retail and wholesale prices, with console logging and TODOs for future Merkle root integration and real payout systems.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page component that fetches and displays contact information and an e-contract iframe portal from the backend actor, with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring hero section, platform features (unlimited scraping, arbitrage engine, Merkle tracing), and a three-stage development roadmap with navigation to products and services.
frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.tsx: Client registration page that generates a unique client ID (unixTimestamp + 10-digit mobile number), stores it in localStorage, and displays a QR code for the generated ID.
frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx: Products listing page that displays aggregated products from the backend, allows mock order creation with client ID validation, computes arbitrage margins, and shows order trace hashes for created orders.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: React component that displays a grid of services fetched from the backend actor, showing service title, source URL, price with currency formatting, and a link to view details.
frontend/src/pages/Sitemap.tsx: React component that displays application routes grouped by role (owner/admin/client/global) in tables, showing path, priority level, and access control with color-coded badges.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography, container queries, animations (accordion, fade-in), and extended theme with custom fonts and shadows.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting a staged e-commerce aggregator platform implementation with product/service listings, mock scraper, order API, QRC onboarding, and sitemap generation across three development stages.
